subject: Hosted API eval: quickstart, endpoints & rate limits
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Luke Perez <luke.perez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API eval: quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Hi Sarah / Luke —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can get your team running an evaluation on Redwood Hosted API this week:

1) Quickstart (what I shared on the call)
- Eval signup: https://app.redwood.ai/signup?eval=acme — use your work email and CC me so I can attach the trial quota.
- Post-signup: we'll provision a trial API key and a sandbox org with default limits.

2) Endpoints (examples)
- Text generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Chat: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
- Embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
- Example curl (generation):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1.4","input":"Summarize the clinical note:\n\n..."}'

3) Rate limits & quotas (trial defaults)
- Requests: 60 req/min (burstable)
- Concurrent streams: 10 concurrent requests
- Token throughput: ~100k tokens/min shared across the org
- If you expect higher sustained rates we can request a quota increase for the POC or discuss Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput.

4) Data & retention notes
- Hosted API: request payloads are encrypted in transit and at rest; we offer opt-out of retention for PII-sensitive projects (details in SOC2 packet).
- Private/Dedicated: recommended if you require VPC-only networking, customer-managed keys, or strict on-prem constraints.

5) Next steps
- Please reply with rough expected peak concurrency (concurrent requests) and daily token volume so we can size the trial quotas.
- I attached a one-page quickstart and a mapping template to capture sample prompts / inputs.
- Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up on Thu 3/4 to review POC success criteria?

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf]
[Attachment: acme-mapping-template.xlsx]

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Perez <luke.perez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval: quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side before we spin up the eval:

- Expected usage: our initial POC will be ~500k tokens/day, with short spikes up to ~5 RPS during peak test runs. Concurrency-wise we may need ~20 concurrent requests for the test harness.
- Data retention: we need confirmation that input data (PHI/PII) can be excluded from Redwood retention for the POC. Is the opt-out available on the Hosted eval or only in Dedicated/Private?
- Security/compliance: can you share the SOC2 packet and the retention opt-out flow?

If Hosted eval supports a retention opt-out and we can bump concurrency for the trial, Hosted would be ideal for rapid testing. If not, we may need to look at Dedicated (or Private for production).

Also happy to take the follow-up on Thu 3/4 — 10am PT works for us.

Best,
Sarah
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval: quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Sarah —

Quick answers from the SE side:
- Concurrency: trial defaults are 10 concurrent; we can temporarily increase to 20 for your POC once the eval org is created (please provide the account email so we can add the quota).
- Token/day: 500k tokens/day is fine for a POC on Hosted. If you expect sustained throughput >200k tokens/day over multiple weeks, we often recommend Dedicated for cost predictability and reserved capacity.
- Retention opt-out: for Hosted eval we can enable data non-retention for the trial org (it prevents data logging for model improvement). For regulated workloads we recommend Private (VPC) or Dedicated with KMS integration.
- Networking: Hosted is internet-facing; if you need VPC-only access or customer-managed keys, we support that in Dedicated/Private.

I'll prepare the SOC2 packet and a short doc that explains how to enable non-retention for the trial. Marissa — if you can create the eval org for Sarah (or let me know the signup email) I will request the temporary quota increase.

- Aditya (SE)
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]
